# Unlisted annual-filing source replays

These eight cases start without a saved Company, a per-issuer qualification policy or an AI response. The production graph extracts source values and qualification independently reconstructs them. Seven cases qualify under the current rules. MET is withheld for unresolved historical parent/consolidated equity scope; a source-backed number alone cannot establish a valid parent-equity ROE model. NVDA requires a reconciled debt-note total/split when its sole finance-related signal is historical asset amortization; actual liabilities or new activity still require complete coverage. BAC uses annual paid-common cash DPS directly, with its per-share unit and source concept retained. Declared/all-shareholder dividends are never substituted. These outcomes test defined rules, not general extraction accuracy or investment value.

Each manifest records SHA-256 hashes of the original downloaded SEC documents and the fixture content. The compressed inline fixtures retain every numeric fact, context, unit, document identity and row label; surrounding prose is removed. Original schema/presentation/calculation documents and SEC submissions metadata are included. Company-facts fixtures retain annual records from 2020 onward, including conflicting duplicates and later restatements, plus explicit NVDA split-event metadata. No saved values or human corrections are extraction inputs.

`python -m eval.reusable_cold` runs this set. `tests/test_reusable_inputs.py` adds missing-operand, conflicting-value, wrong-entity/unit/context, shortened-history, model-scope, mutation and public API withholding checks. Original complete source snapshots and live release evidence are retained outside the repository; fixtures are selected-source regression material, not a complete filing archive.
